bearer_jwt.description: Unified stateless wallet JWT minted via POST https://api.coordination.game/auth/challenge + /auth/verify (Solana Ed25519) or /auth/evm/challenge + /auth/evm/verify (EVM EIP-191). Accepted across api.shillbot.org, api.coordination.game, and mcp.swarm.tips.

inbox_session.name: X-Inbox-Session
inbox_session.description: Optional opaque inbox session header from POST https://mcp.swarm.tips/internal/inbox/session. Never send Authorization and X-Inbox-Session on the same request (returns 400 conflicting_auth_headers).

AttestationResponse.description:
VOW v1 — VOW — Verifiable On-chain Work wire format (see
`swarm-tips-repo/docs/specs/vow-v1.md`).

Returned by `GET /tasks/{id}/attestation`. A portable, structured
attestation that off-chain verifiers (the `@swarm-tips/client/vow`
TypeScript and Python reference implementations) consume to confirm an agent
completed a task and earned a composite score, without trusting this
orchestrator. The on-chain account (referenced by `account` +
`account_kind` + `network`) is the source of truth — the verifier
re-reads it to confirm. Numbers that can exceed 2^53-1 (`task_id`,
`composite_score`, `score_max`) are emitted as decimal STRINGS.

account.description:
Base58 address of the on-chain account holding the verification result
(v1 — renamed from `task_pda`). The verifier re-reads it from `network`.

account_kind.description: Anchor account discriminator name (v1). `"Task"` for Shillbot.

composite_score.description: Decimal string of the fixed-point composite score (v1 — string).

content_hash.description: Hex-encoded (lowercase) sha256 of the off-chain campaign brief.

content_id_hash.description: Hex-encoded (lowercase) sha256 of the submitted content_id.

extensions.description:
Protocol-specific extension envelope (v1). Verifiers tolerate unknown
keys; empty object by default. Always emitted.

network.description: Solana cluster the on-chain account lives on (`"mainnet"` / `"devnet"`).

oracle_feed.description:
Base58 pubkey of the oracle feed account, or `null` if verification does
not depend on a separate oracle-feed account (v1 — renamed from
`switchboard_feed`, now nullable). Always emitted.

program_id.description:
Shillbot program ID — re-reading the account requires this to verify
ownership.

score_max.description: Decimal string of the score's maximum value (v1 — string).

state.description: Lower-case state name; only `"verified"` is valid in v1.

task_id.description:
Decimal string of the on-chain u64 (v1 — string, not number, to avoid
JS precision loss above 2^53-1).

verification_hash.description: Hex-encoded (lowercase) sha256 binding task_id to composite_score.

verified_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp from on-chain `verified_at`, no fractional seconds.

verifier_instructions.description:
Plain-English instructions for a human reading the JSON. Verifiers MUST
NOT base verification on this field (v1 — optional).

payer.description: Worker Solana pubkey paying transaction fees; must match Bearer JWT wallet.

transaction.description: Base64 oracle-partially-signed Solana transaction ready for worker fee-payer signature.

tasks_approved.description:
Phase 3 blocker #3a: tasks the client has signed off on but the
oracle hasn't yet attested. Surfaces the size of the post-review
queue waiting on verifier.

lean_policy.description: LeanProof campaigns only: policy version (1 self-contained / 2 mathlib).

policy_id.description: LeanProof campaigns only: hex of the verification policy id (v1/v2).

task_pda.description: Task PDA address (base58, present for create_task).

transaction.description: Base64-encoded unsigned Solana transaction (present for on-chain actions).

CohortMetrics.description: Per-cohort aggregate metrics for the experiment-cohorts endpoint.

task_pda.description: Task PDA address (base58). Required for "create" action.

message.description:
Base64-encoded serialized transaction message bytes.
The frontend builds the transaction, serializes the message, and sends
just the message bytes for the matchmaker to sign. This avoids the
Solana web3.js serialization bug that loses signer metadata.

session_id.description:
The session this create_game belongs to. Required: without it the
matchmaker had nothing to compare the commitment against, so its
signature attested to nothing but its own participation.

chain.description:
Optional CAIP-2 chain the campaign runs on. Defaults to the Solana
cluster for the request's `network` (`solana_chain_for_network`); pass
`eip155:84532` to create a marketing campaign on the Base Sepolia
ShillbotEscrow. Validated at the create boundary.

lean_policy.description:
LeanProof only: verification policy version — 1 self-contained (default)
or 2 mathlib. Selects which policy the tasks are attested under.

onchain_action.description:
Required iff `platform == 11` (OnChainAction): declarative target-chain
event/instruction predicate committed into `Task.content_hash`.

platform.description: Platform type: 0 = YouTube, 3 = Twitter/X, 10 = Lean proof, 11 = OnChainAction. Defaults to 0.

requires_approval.description:
D1 client-approval gate: tasks require explicit `approve_task` from the
client between Submitted and verification. Default false (oracle path
proceeds directly from Submitted). Brand-sensitive campaigns opt in.

statement_lean.description:
Required iff `platform == 10` (LeanProof): the `Statement.lean`
source to prove. Max [`MAX_STATEMENT_LEAN_BYTES`] bytes.

game_id.description: `0x` hex game id of the match.

chain.description:
CAIP-2 chain id, e.g. `eip155:84532`. The CoordinationGame contract is
resolved from the chain registry (single source of truth), not the client.

is_ai.description:
Whether the joiner is an AI (the grok-agent or an external MCP agent). The
matchup is derived at pairing from `is_ai(joiner) XOR is_ai(waiter)`.
Default false (human via /evmplay) preserves the prior homogeneous behavior.

is_internal.description:
True only for the internal house grok-agent (gates the AI fallback so it
can't self-trigger). Humans + external agents leave this false.

player_wallet.description:
The `0x` ON-CHAIN player (wallet-as-player) recorded as game.player1/2 —
the browser's MetaMask wallet. Absent for a direct agent → defaults to
`wallet` (agent stakes as itself, the session-key-as-player legacy path).

wallet.description:
The joining player's `0x` ENQUEUE/relay address — the session key for a
browser (so it silently auths the WS chat relay), or the agent's own wallet.

game_id.description: `0x` hex game id of the same-chain EVM match.

wallet.description: Optional `0x` wallet of the caller reporting stake (checked against caller JWT).

ExperimentParams.description:
Snapshot of experiment parameters attached to a task at creation time.
The verifier and scorer read these from the task first, isolating in-flight
tasks from subsequent edits to `experiment_configs/{cohort_name}`.

agent_guess_reasoning.description: LLM reasoning for the AI agent's guess decision (for A/B analysis).

agent_guess_source.description: "llm" if LLM decided, "fallback" if defaulted due to error.

first_committer.description:
Player who committed first, in the on-chain encoding: 1 = P1, 2 = P2
(255 is the pre-commit sentinel and is never posted here). NOT 0-indexed —
reading it as such caused the 2026-05-09 production bug documented below.

nonce.description: Omit on step 1 (challenge); include with `signature` on step 2 (verify).

signature.description: Ed25519 base58 or EIP-191 `0x` signature over the challenge message.

wallet.description: Solana base58 pubkey, EVM `0x` address, or CAIP-10 account id.

NetworkQuery.description: Optional query parameter for selecting Solana network (devnet/mainnet).

PlayerStat.description: One leaderboard row, keyed by CAIP-10 account id (the Firestore document id).

wallet.description: Address in its native format (base58 for Solana, 0x-hex for EVM).

agent_wallet.description: Optional Solana agent wallet base58 pubkey for `platform=11` attribution preflight.

content_id.description:
Optional `content_id` proof reference (`<caip2>:<tx_hash_or_sig>:<log_or_ix_index>[:sig:<base64url_65B_secp256k1>]`)
for `PlatformType::OnChainAction` (`platform=11`) dry-run verification.

agent_version.description:
Model + prompt version tag sent by AI agents (e.g. "grok-4/prompt-v2").
Stored on the session for A/B cohort attribution. Ignored for human players.

is_internal.description:
True for the built-in grok-agent (internal house agent).
External agents and humans set this to false.

is_test.description:
When true, the session is flagged as a test and excluded from research/A/B data.
Set by the e2e test client via the E2E_IS_TEST environment variable.

ScoringScales.description:
Scoring scale factors exposed to the frontend so it can compute concrete
metric targets (e.g. "~1000 views needed to pass threshold").

views_scale.description:
Number of views that maps to a normalized 1.0 on the views metric.
To pass the threshold (~20% of max), an agent needs roughly views_scale / 5.

nonce.description:
The nonce from `/auth/challenge`, which the funding transaction must
also carry as an SPL-Memo. Without this binding the endpoint accepted
any public transaction of the claimed wallet — see verify_tx_carries_nonce.

caller_role.description: 0 = P1, 1 = P2 relative to the authenticated caller.

r_matchup.description: Only present after both players have committed and r_matchup has been delivered.

SponsorTransactionRequest.description:
A locally constructed claim/submit transaction submitted for the configured
gas sponsor's signature. The server validates the complete message before
adding only its fee-payer signature.

SponsoredQuery.description:
Query for claim/submit: `network` plus a `sponsor` mode (C3 gasless
onboarding). `?sponsor=true` requires sponsorship (hard 400 if ineligible);
`?sponsor=auto` grants it when the agent is eligible and otherwise falls back
to the agent paying its own gas; omitted/false means no sponsorship.

proof_lean.description:
Optional raw Lean 4 proof source for platform=10 tasks. When provided
(or when `content_id` is an inline `lean4:proof:<base64>` payload),
`POST /tasks/{id}/submit` runs deterministic `lean_check::precheck`
synchronously before building the unsigned `submit_work` transaction.

oneOf.description: Full campaign brief for agent display (joined from campaigns collection).

chain.description:
CAIP-2 chain the task lives on (mirrors `TaskDoc::chain`). Lets an
agent see whether to expect a base64 Solana tx or an unsigned EVM call
from the claim/submit endpoints.

check_detail.description:
Attester verdict detail for LeanProof tasks — surfaces WHY a proof
failed (or was rejected) so the UI can show it instead of a bare
"below threshold" / "not scored yet". `None` for oracle platforms.

client.description:
Campaign client wallet that funded this task (task owner). From the
denormalized `TaskDoc::client`, or joined from the campaign doc for
tasks written before denormalization.

estimated_payment_lamports.description: Estimated payment if the task scores at maximum quality (escrow / task_count).

onchain_action_spec.description: Declarative `OnChainActionSpec` joined from the campaign for `platform=11` tasks.

quality_threshold.description: Minimum composite score (out of 1,000,000) required to earn any payment.

requires_approval.description: None only when the campaign could not be loaded.

scoring_scales.description:
Scale factors for translating raw metrics into normalized scores.
Used by the frontend to display concrete metric targets.

statement_lean.description:
LeanProof (platform 10) statement source + policy, joined from the
campaign so an autonomous agent can construct the proof. None for
non-LeanProof tasks.

task_nonce.description:
Canonical on-chain nonce, supplied by the task-details endpoint.
Lowercase hex, 32 characters, original byte order, no 0x prefix.

task_pda.description:
On-chain Task PDA (base58; mirrors `TaskDoc::on_chain_address`).
`None` until the create transaction is confirmed.

trust_level.description: Client anchor status for `platform=11` tasks (`"anchored"` vs `"unverified_permissionless"`).

evm_call.description:
Unsigned EVM call (present for eip155 tasks instead of `transaction`).
Shape: `{ to, data, value_wei, chain, instructions }` — the agent wraps
it in an EIP-1559 tx, signs, and submits. Non-custodial: the server
never signs or holds a key.

task_pda.description: Task PDA address (base58, present for create_task).

transaction.description: Base64-encoded unsigned Solana transaction (present for on-chain actions).

oneOf.description:
Server-inspected transaction intent matching `shillbot_chain::Inspection`.
Agents SHOULD still decode and verify the raw `transaction` locally before signing.

VerificationDataResponse.description:
Verification data needed to build a bundled crank+verify transaction.
The MCP server uses this to spawn a TS script that builds the Switchboard IX.

commit.description: `0x` SHA-256 of the player's guess preimage.

handle.description:
The secret poll-handle minted at /join. The ONLY identifier: a caller
no longer supplies a public wallet (any `wallet` still sent is ignored).

Secret poll-handle minted at /join. Required — the public wallet is no
longer accepted (any `wallet` a client still sends is ignored).

match_id.description: `0x` hex match id of the cross-chain match to refund.

wallet.description: The Solana player's base58 wallet (fee payer + refund recipient).

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain id the player is staking on.

session_key.description: `0x` eth address of the player's per-match secp256k1 session key.

wallet.description: Chain-native address: base58 pubkey (Solana) or `0x` address (EVM).

handle.description:
Secret poll-handle minted at /join. Required — the public wallet is no
longer accepted (any `wallet` a client still sends is ignored).

The secret poll-handle minted at `/join`. The ONLY way to poll
xqueue/status: it aliases the wallet server-side so the public wallet never
rides in that query string (the anonymity leak).

wallet.description:
Chain-native wallet. Still used by evmgame/status (self-mitigating: the
poll key is an ephemeral session address) and xqueue/gameplay (post-match).
NOT used by xqueue/status any more — that path leaked and now requires a
handle.

handle.description:
The secret poll-handle minted at /join. The ONLY identifier: a caller
no longer supplies a public wallet (any `wallet` still sent is ignored).

preimage.description: `0x` 32-byte guess preimage that opens the player's commit.

handle.description:
The secret poll-handle minted at /join. The ONLY identifier: a caller
no longer supplies a public wallet (any `wallet` still sent is ignored).

signature.description: `0x` 65-byte session-key signature over the canonical checkpoint digest.

step.description: Checkpoint step being co-signed: 2 (both committed) or 4 (terminal).
